OmniMusik · screenshots

OmniMusik Screens

An iOS app that puts music you own and music you stream into one library, with a real-time effects chain for the files you own, and a web companion for editing the same playlists from a desktop. Every screen below is the shipped app.

On the phone

Swift, SwiftUI, AVAudioEngine. Tap any screen to enlarge.

On the web

React and TypeScript on CloudFront, against a Spring Boot and Postgres API.

Source and write-ups: github.com/obi47n/OmniMusik · obinnaduruaku.com
